messages:
Mia: Quick heads-up — planning to lift the soft-pin on runtime for the llama3q-quant canary in tonight's 02:00 UTC window. Wanted to surface compatibility notes and get ops sign-off.

Sandeep: @Mia what runtime version are we unpinning from and which kernel tweaks landed? :eyes:

Mia: We're currently pinned to runtime 2.14.1 because of the KV-cache patch mismatch. Unpin target is runtime 2.16.0; it contains the attention-kernel reorder and a small kv cache boundary fix.

Anna-Ops: Are there any known long-sequence regressions? Last time long-seq timeouts spiked after an unpin.

Mia: We ran microbenchmarks earlier: no OOMs, but tail latency +10% for sequences >8k on a subset of quantized configs. That's expected; we plan to enable the incremental batching tweak to mitigate.

Tim: Can we soft-roll with a pinlist exception for high-throughput cohorts? I don't want customer-facing traffic to hit the canary until we validate fallback.

Mia: Yes — plan is staged unpin: 5% traffic for first 30m, then 25% for next hour. DeployBot will hold an automatic revert if 5xx rate >0.5% or avg latency regression >25% vs baseline.

DeployBot: Pin/unpin plan created: action=soft-unpin runtime=2.16.0 model_group=llama3q-quant window=2026-03-23T02:00:00Z traffic_ramp=[5,25,100] rollback_triggers=["5xx>0.5%","latency>25%"] — runbook attached.

Sandeep: Who's owning the rollback? If we hit threshold, will deploybot auto-rollback or notify and pause?

Mia: DeployBot auto-rollbacks on thresholds. Ops will receive a page and SRE will manually validate post-rollback. I'll also keep a PR open that pins runtime back to 2.14.1 so we can quick-reapply if needed.

Anna-Ops: Confirmed — I'll have a small team on watch during the window and will monitor the canary dashboards and the DB connection pool metrics.

Docs-Beth: Heads up for release notes: need a line about the kernel reorder and potential latency impact on long sequences, and an ops note about the rollback triggers. I'll open a docs PR now.

Mia: Thanks — two quick asks: 1) @Sandeep can you confirm the SDK shim compatibility? 2) @Docs-Beth add an ops bullet for upgrading dedicated capacity clients (some internal clients pin runtime via agent).

Sandeep: SDK side is fine for v3 clients; older v2 clients that hard-pin runtime in agent config may need a hotpatch. I'll create a short compatibility script to scan pinlists and emit warnings.

DeployBot: Compatibility scan queued: found 7 customers with hard runtime pins (agent-v2). Notifying SEs.

Mia: Perfect. If nothing surprising is flagged in the next 3 hours we'll proceed with the staged unpin. Final call at 01:15 UTC.

Anna-Ops: Acknowledge. I'll post in #eng-oncall at 01:10 with the final go/no-go.

Tim: Thumbs up from infra side.

Mia: OK — tagging this thread 'action:nightly-unpin' and will update with the final signal. :thumbsup:
